_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N364328 (2026-09-09, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: "RE: The tariff classification, country of origin, and eligibility of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) of a safety gate"). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held Mexico. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (7323.99.9040). Family and name: the family check (furniture, 0.75); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (0: none). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target China by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for China are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570.
